name: Emberdraught
description: A swallow of banked firelight. It does not warm you so much as remind you what you were going to cast.

name: Sapwine Flask
description: Pressed from the wood's own sap and left to turn. It tastes of bark and it works, which is all anyone asks of it.

name: Wychroot Tonic
description: Dug from under the oldest tree on the ridge and boiled down twice. The vendor will not say what the second boiling is for.

name: Watcher's Lantern
description: It sheds no light you can read by. What it does is leave one behind wherever you have been standing long enough.

name: Tally-Stick
description: A hazel stick with nothing cut into it yet. Every takedown and every great beast you bring down earns it a notch.
passive_text: Jungle starter, Fell only, one per bag. Takedowns and large monsters add tallies. Upgrades into a brand.

name: Almsgiver's Coin
description: Given, never spent.
passive_text: When you damage an enemy champion, the most wounded allied champion within 6m heals 12 + 3 per level. Once every 6s.

name: Fletcher's Wax
description: Beeswax for the bowstring. It keeps the damp out.
passive_text: Killing a minion or monster gives 8% attack speed for 3s, stacking 3 times.

name: Hedgewife's Poultice
description: Moss and honey in linen, and something she would not name.
passive_text: When you drop below 40% health, heal 70 + 6 per level over 5s. Once every 45s.

name: Novice's Slate
description: First-year spells in chalk. The useful part is what the teacher added.
passive_text: When your ability hits an enemy champion, restore 12 mana. Once every 4s.

name: Reaver's Whetstone
description: A field stone worn hollow by one arm.
passive_text: Your first basic on an enemy champion after 5s without hitting one deals 18 bonus physical damage.

name: Sentry's Kettle-Hat
description: Standard issue, dented flat across the crown.
passive_text: When an enemy champion hits you with a basic, your next basic on them within 3s deals 15 bonus physical damage.

name: Trailblazer's Sandals
description: Cut for the first mile rather than the last. You will replace them, and you will miss them.

name: Farsight Brazier
description: Coals that were lit at the first watchfire and have never once been out. They are in a hurry to be somewhere new.

name: Swift Boots
description: Featherlight boots stitched from wind-tanned leather. Win the lane by outrunning it.

name: Thistledown
description: Seed fluff twisted in paper. It wants to be somewhere else.

name: Apprentice Focus
description: A cracked lens that still bends a spell true.

name: Iron Shard
description: A palm of cold pig iron.

name: Long Blade
description: A dependable length of sharpened steel.

name: Null Cloak
description: Woven from thread that spells forget mid-sentence.

name: Regrowth Charm
description: A sprig of everbloom sealed in amber.

name: Duelist Gloves
description: Supple gloves that never lose their grip.

name: Giant's Ring
description: A band sized for a giant's finger, worn as a bracer.

name: Rowan Cross
description: Two rowan twigs bound in red thread. Nothing ill steps over it.

name: Bloodied Kerchief
description: It never washes clean, and the owner stopped trying.

name: Kindled Wick
description: Burns steady in wind that puts torches out.

name: Scribe's Inkhorn
description: Every spell the owner ever paid for went through this ink.

name: Billhook
description: A hedge-layer's blade with a hook at the tip.

name: Chronicler's Cuff
description: The sand in it runs a little to the left of now.

name: Ember Lens
description: Glass with a coal still burning at its heart.

name: Serrated Fang
description: Pulled from something that bit through a shield.

name: Studded Belt
description: Thick hide, ugly, and studded all the way round.

name: Hagstone
description: A stone with a hole worn through it. Spells look back at you through it.

name: Bulwark Slab
description: Quarried, not forged, and strapped on with rope.

name: Sprinter's Greaves
description: Plated at the shin and nowhere else. Everything that matters is already past you.

name: Warded Striders
description: Sigils stitched into the sole, face down, so every step presses them into the ground.

name: Hunter's Pace
description: Light boots cut for open ground. You arrive first, which is usually the whole trick.

name: Magpie Cage
description: The bird in it screams at anyone who touches what is yours.
passive_text: When an enemy destroys one of your wards, they are revealed for 4s.

name: Sorcerer's Treads
description: The buckles are set with the same stone as a good wand. Walking in them costs a spell less.

name: Ash Censer
description: Swung once over the dead, and never cleaned.
passive_text: Enemy champions you damage with abilities heal 35% less for 3s.

name: Salt Knife
description: Kept in the salt box, and it remembers.
passive_text: Enemy champions you damage heal 35% less for 3s.

name: Tidewarden's Pearl
description: Cool to the touch, always.
passive_text: While below 50% mana, your mana regen is doubled.

name: Vampire's Draught
description: Half a mouthful left, and it has been half full for a century.
passive_text: Below 40% health, your lifesteal heals double.

name: Windshear Bow
description: Strung with something that hums before you draw it.
passive_text: Ranged champions reach 0.4m further with basics.

name: Lifebinder's Needle
description: Bone needle, gut thread. It stitches faster than wounds open.
passive_text: Your heals and shields on other champions are 8% stronger.

name: Whisperglass
description: Ground from a still lake at dusk.
passive_text: After 5s without casting, your next ability winds up 30% faster.

name: Skirmisher's Talon
description: Long enough to end the argument.
passive_text: Your basics deal 12 bonus physical damage to champions moving away from you.

name: Solace Reliquary
description: Holds one feather and a great deal of patience.
passive_text: When crowd control lands on an allied champion within 6m, they gain a shield of 30 + 15% AP for 2s. Once every 12s.

name: Wayfarer's Banner
description: Carried ahead of the column, never behind it.
passive_text: Allied champions within 5m of you gain 0.35 move speed while heading toward an enemy champion.

name: Eclipse Prism
description: Split light goes in and one dark line comes out.
passive_text: When an enemy champion's ability hits you, your next ability hit on them within 4s deals 30 bonus magic damage.

name: Hollow Point Quiver
description: Every shaft bored out down its length.
passive_text: Your basics ignore 15% of the target's armour.

name: Wardstone Mantle
description: A slab of altar stone worn like a promise.
passive_text: When an enemy champion's ability hits you, regenerate 1% of your max health a second for 3s. Once every 8s.

name: Warlord's Skull-Cup
description: He drinks from the last one who stood against him.
passive_text: Champion takedowns heal you for 8% of your max health.

name: Cinderglass Torch
description: The flame is set inside the glass, not on top of it.
passive_text: Your ability hits reveal enemy champions for 2s.

name: Frostmarrow Sigil
description: Cold enough to ache through the glove.
passive_text: A hit that takes more than 8% of your max health gives you 15 armour for 2s. Once every 6s.

name: Mothknife
description: Grey as moth dust and about as loud.
passive_text: Your first hit on an enemy champion who could not see you deals 25 bonus physical damage. Once every 8s per champion.

name: Ivy Girdle
description: Woven green and still growing.
passive_text: Each time an enemy champion damages you, gain 1 health regen for 5s, stacking up to 8.

name: Runewarden's Tome
description: Chained shut, and the chain is the spell.
passive_text: When your ability hits an enemy champion, gain a shield of 25 + 10% AP for 2s. Once every 8s.

name: Spellbreaker Shroud
description: Woven from a silence.
passive_text: Slows on you last 25% shorter.

name: Aegis of the Line
description: Built to lock edge to edge with the one beside it.
passive_text: Minions and monsters deal you 20% less damage, and towers 10% less.

name: Rendfang Pick
description: A tooth on a handle. The handle was the afterthought.
passive_text: Your first ability hit on an enemy champion every 6s deals 20 bonus physical damage.

name: Dockhand's Knuckles
description: Cast in one piece. The best guard is hitting first.
passive_text: Your first basic on an enemy champion every 6s gives you a shield of 40 + 4% of your bonus health for 2s.

name: Sootbrand
description: A tally-stick hatchet with a dead lantern for a head. Whoever carries it brings the dark along.
active_text: For 4s, wards, towers and minions cannot see you; enemy champions within 7m still can. Dealing or taking damage ends it. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (30s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle brand for assassins (Fell only). At 15 tallies, Snuff the Lantern lasts 5s and taking damage no longer ends it.

name: Teasel Jerkin
description: Stitched with the dried heads of teasels, the burrs wool-carders use.
passive_text: Champions who basic attack you get a burr (up to 4, for 5s). Your next hit on them tears the burrs out for 12 + 1% of your max health magic damage each.

name: Wychbrand
description: A tally-stick of wych-elm, scored with smouldering witch-marks.
active_text: Target a point within 8m. After 0.6s, a 2.5m ring deals 50 + 35% AP + 4 per tally magic damage (50% more to monsters). Champions hit take 10% more damage from your abilities for 3s. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (30s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle brand for spell junglers (Fell only). Your abilities deal 15% more damage to monsters. At 15 tallies, Count Them Off's ring is 3m and the mark lasts 4s.

name: Singing Horseshoe
description: Nailed over the door. It rings a low note when trouble comes up the path.
passive_text: Allied champions within 5m of you gain 3 armour and 3 magic resist for each enemy champion within 8m of you, up to 12 each.

name: Wakebrand
description: A notched staff hung with a paper lantern on a bone hook. It leaves a light burning wherever its keeper has been.
passive_text: Jungle brand for tanks (Fell only). Monsters at the camp you fight take 10 + 1.5% of your max health magic damage a second. Each camp you clear leaves a lantern for 90s (up to 4) that sees 6m and reveals enemy champions who enter. At 15 tallies: up to 6 lanterns, and they slow intruders 25%.

name: Marrowbrand
description: A thighbone from the hound ossuary. The pack still answers to it.
active_text: Near a camp (6m): its monsters attack the nearest enemy champion within 9m for 4s. If none is near, the camp does not attack you for 3s. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (40s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle brand for fighters (Fell only). At 15 tallies, roused monsters hunt for 5s and deal 25% more damage.

name: Stormcaller's Crown
description: Worn by those who ask the sky for favours and are answered.
passive_text: Each full second without casting builds 1 Calm, up to 5. Your next ability's first hit deals 6% more damage per Calm.

name: War-Scythe
description: A scythe blade set straight on its pole. Too long to parry, too heavy to stop.
passive_text: Each basic on the same target within 2.5s adds 1 Weight (up to 5): +5% basic damage each. At 5 Weight your basic interrupts casts, channels and recalls and slows 30% for 1s, then Weight drops to 2. Once per target every 6s.

name: Crowscarer's Sling
description: For clearing a field of crows before they can settle.
passive_text: When your basic kills a minion or monster, 40% of the hit splashes on enemies within 2m of it (not champions).

name: Curfew Horn
description: Blown round the walls at midnight, and again at three.
passive_text: Your wards take 2 hits to destroy, and an enemy who destroys one is revealed for 6s.

name: Ironhide Plating
description: Scale salvaged from something that used to win fights.
passive_text: Champions who basic attack you get a burr (up to 4, for 5s). Your next hit on them tears the burrs out for 12 + 1% of your max health magic damage each.

name: Beater's Rattle
description: The beaters go in first. Nothing stays in the bracken once it starts.
passive_text: Enemy champions within 5m of you cannot hide in brush.

name: Colossus Heart
description: Still beating, and it was never in a person.
passive_text: Knockbacks, drags and pulls move you half as far, and knock-ups on you last 40% less.

name: Hazel Rod
description: Forked hazel. It dips for water, and for people hiding.
active_text: Enemy champions within 12m are revealed to your team for 2s.
passive_text: When an enemy champion you cannot see comes within 8m of you, you are warned.

name: Sunderer's Greatblade
description: Too much sword for one person.
active_text: Aim a line: after 0.5s the ground splits 7m ahead, dealing 90 + 90% bonus AD physical damage. The crack stands for 3s as a low wall enemies can't walk through (dashes go over).

name: Wraithstring Bow
description: Strung with a hair from a hanged man. It fires twice.
passive_text: 0.35s after your basic lands on a champion or monster, a ghost arrow hits it for 30% of the damage as magic damage.

name: Grudgefire Crucible
description: A furnace small enough to carry, stoked with every blow you took.
active_text: Aim: vent all your Grudge in a 5m cone as magic damage equal to the Grudge + 40% AP, healing for 35% of what it deals to champions.
passive_text: 20% of the damage champions deal you is stored as Grudge, up to 350. It drains once you are out of champion fights for 5s.

name: Harewitch Staff
description: The witch who carried it was seen as a hare more often than not.
passive_text: After 3s without dealing or taking champion damage, gain 0.6 move speed.

name: Otter-Spear
description: Barbed so the catch stays on, however hard it pulls.
passive_text: Your hits barb enemy champions for 3s. A barbed champion who dashes, blinks or Bolts is pinned where they land for 0.6s and revealed for 2s (once per champion every 10s).

name: Sworn Charter
description: Sealed in wax and sworn on. It reads every curse twice before it lets one in.
passive_text: The first stun, slow, fear or taunt on you every 15s lasts half as long.

name: Archivist's Grimoire
description: Every page is an index to a page you have not reached.
passive_text: When an ability hits no enemy champion, refund 20% of its cooldown.

name: Brinecutter
description: Pickled in the sea for a year. It stings worse than it cuts.
passive_text: Enemy champions you damage heal 40% less for 3s.

name: Cat's-Eye Ring
description: A cat sees what is coming. So does whoever wears this.
passive_text: When an enemy champion dashes or blinks to within 4m of you, gain a shield of 60 + 25% AP for 2s and 1 move speed that fades over 1.5s. Once every 15s.

name: Drover's Hook
description: For bringing back the ones that wander.
passive_text: Your basics on an enemy champion who is moving away from you drag them 0.5m toward you. Once every 2s per champion.

name: Felling Wedge
description: The bigger the tree, the better it works.
passive_text: Your basics deal bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's bonus health.

name: Ferryman's Oar
description: Worn smooth by one pair of hands. Nobody goes over the side while it rows.
passive_text: When an allied champion within 8m dashes or uses Bolt, they gain a shield of 50 + 20% AP for 2s when they land. Once per ally every 10s.

name: Fire-Raiser's Brazier
description: Carried coals from a fire that burned a village.
passive_text: Enemy champions within 3.5m of you heal 30% less, or 50% less while you are below 50% health.

name: Graverobber's Jemmy
description: For lids that were nailed down for a reason.
passive_text: Your damage to shields is 30% higher.

name: Hare's-Foot Knife
description: Lucky for the one holding it. Not for the hare.
passive_text: A champion takedown gives you 1 move speed that fades over 3s, and you pass through units for 3s.

name: Hound's Collar
description: Spiked on the outside, for the wolves.
passive_text: When an enemy champion damages an allied champion within 6m of you, gain 0.8 move speed toward that enemy for 2s. Once every 8s.

name: Owlhush Darts
description: Fletched with owl feathers. They make no sound on the way in.
passive_text: When you hit an enemy champion who could not see you, their sight shrinks to 3m for 2s.

name: Pyre Urn
description: What is left after the pyre, carried home.
passive_text: Enemy champions you damage with abilities heal 40% less for 3s.

name: Scrying Bowl
description: Fill it with black water and do not look away.
passive_text: Your abilities deal 15% more damage to champions your team cannot see, and reveal them for 2s.

name: Tempest Repeater
description: The string never fully stops moving.
active_text: For 3.5s you basic attack while moving, at 75% speed and 0.5m less reach.

name: Wattle Hurdle
description: Woven hazel, set against the wind. Whatever stands behind it stays dry.
passive_text: Allied champions within 3m behind you (on your far side from the nearest enemy champion) take 10% less damage.

name: Weather Vane
description: The iron cock turns toward trouble.
passive_text: Your heals and shields on an ally are 10% stronger for each enemy champion within 6m of them, up to 30%.

name: Wisp Net
description: Swept over the bog at night. It lets the lights out one at a time, to find the hurt.
passive_text: Every 8s, your next ability hit on an enemy champion sends a wisp to the most wounded allied champion within 8m, healing them 30 + 15% AP.

name: Bailiff's Mace
description: Built by someone who got tired of shields.
passive_text: When your damage breaks an enemy champion's shield, it bites for 60 + 60% bonus AD physical damage and cuts their healing and shields 40% for 4s. Once per champion every 8s.

name: Millstone Collar
description: Worn round the neck. Heavy enough to drown in.
passive_text: An enemy champion who hits you with 4 basics within 3s is blinded for 1s: their basics miss. Once every 8s per champion.

name: Rime Pane
description: Cracked from corner to corner by the frost, and still holding.
passive_text: Once every 8s, a hit that would take more than 12% of your max health takes only 12% now; the rest is paid over the next 3s.

name: Yewlong Bow
description: Cut from a churchyard yew. It has always liked distance.
passive_text: Your basics deal up to 15% more damage the farther the target is: nothing at 3m, the full 15% at 6m.

name: Blightcap
description: A toadstool off the root that killed the oak above it.
passive_text: Your ability hits deal bonus magic damage equal to 3% of the target's bonus health.

name: Bloodsovereign Maul
description: It has never needed sharpening and never will.
active_text: For 4s, heals on you are banked. Then you heal 150% of the bank, and enemies within 3.5m take physical damage equal to 40% of it (up to 80 + 100% bonus AD).

name: Bogfire Peat
description: A sod cut from the bog. It has been burning since before the wood.
passive_text: Your ability hits deal bonus magic damage equal to 1.5% of your max health.

name: Crossroads Dice
description: Rolled at the crossroads at midnight. The dark keeps the score.
active_text: For 4s your ability wind-ups are halved and each ability that hits an enemy champion refunds 30% of its cooldown. Then heals and shields on you are cut 50% for 5s.

name: Everbloom Chalice
description: Something is always flowering in it, out of season and out of soil.
passive_text: Heals and shields you give allied champions also restore 6% of the amount as their mana (or resource).

name: Gamekeeper's Gin
description: Iron jaws, oiled hinge, no warning.
active_text: Throw a trap within 6m. It arms after 1s and lasts 60s (2 at most). The first enemy champion to step on it is chained within 2m of it for 2s and revealed. A dash or blink breaks the chain.
passive_text: Each basic you land on a chained champion holds the chain 0.5s longer, up to 4s in all.

name: Gaoler's Keyring
description: Every key on it opens one door and locks another.
passive_text: Your stuns, pins, roots, taunts and knock-ups on champions last 15% longer.

name: Garrotte Wire
description: Piano wire, from a house that no longer plays.
passive_text: Your first hit on an enemy champion from behind silences them for 0.75s. Once every 10s per champion.

name: Gatehouse Knocker
description: Off the gatehouse door after the siege. Everyone who knocked got an answer.
passive_text: Each time you stun, pin, root, taunt or knock up an enemy champion, gain a shield of 6% of your max health for 3s. Once per champion every 3s.

name: Grandmother's Shawl
description: Knitted by someone who outlived everyone she knitted for.
active_text: Wrap an allied champion within 7m, or yourself: they take 30% less damage from champions for 2.5s.
passive_text: A wrapped champion regenerates 2% of their max health a second.

name: Grounding Iron
description: Cold iron, hammered into the ground at the crossroads.
passive_text: The first enemy ability to hit an allied champion within 5m of you every 10s sends 30% of its damage to you instead.

name: Kiln-Mitt
description: Fired three times, for the hand that reaches into the kiln.
passive_text: Each basic on an enemy champion adds 1 heat (up to 5, for 4s). Your abilities deal 4% more damage per heat.

name: Lych-Bell
description: Rung over the dead so they know to stay down.
active_text: Enemy champions within 3.5m are taunted for 0.75s. The bell tolls again from the same spot 1.5s later, taunting those still within 3.5m for 0.5s.
passive_text: Each champion the bell taunts takes 5s off its cooldown.

name: Orb-Weaver Brooch
description: A black spider of jet, pinned at the throat. It spins while you fight.
passive_text: Each basic or ability you land on an enemy champion spins 1 silk, up to 10. The next champion hit on you is cut by 8 per silk, spending them all.

name: Patience Spindle
description: The thread gets stronger the longer you spin.
passive_text: Shields you give grow by 6% of their size each second they hold, up to 30%.

name: Wishing-Well Bucket
description: Lowered into a well that has never run dry.
passive_text: When you drop below 25% mana, restore 30% of your max mana over 3s. Once every 40s.

name: Alewife's Skillet
description: Off the tavern stove. It has stopped worse than spoons.
passive_text: When enemy champions deal you 30% of your max health within 3s, heal 35% of that over 4s and take 25% less damage for 2s. Once every 45s.

name: Spite Bottle
description: Bent pins, a lock of hair and a cork. Whoever curses you, it finds.
passive_text: When crowd control lands on you, the champion who cast it is revealed for 4s and takes 10% more damage from your team.

name: Wolf-Pelt Mantle
description: Still warm, and still angry.
passive_text: Below 50% health, your basics heal you for 3% of your missing health.

name: Corpse-Candle
description: Seen over the road the night before a death.
passive_text: When you would die, you fight on as a ghost for 3s, then die. Get a champion takedown in that time and you live, at 20% health. Once every 150s.

name: Eelskin Wrap
description: Still slick. Hands slide off it.
passive_text: When crowd control lands on you, gain 1 move speed that fades over 1.5s and pass through units for 1.5s. Once every 12s.

name: Fox's Brush
description: Harder to catch than the fox it came off.
passive_text: While moving, you take 12% less damage from champions.

name: Hedge-Knight's Buckler
description: A poor knight's shield, and a good one.
passive_text: Every 8s, the next champion basic that hits you deals 60% less, and your next basic on that champion within 2s deals 40 + 40% bonus AD bonus physical damage.

name: Keening Comb
description: Found by the river. Pick it up, and she comes looking for it.
passive_text: When a champion's hit takes you below 30% health, enemies within 3m are frightened for 1s. Once every 60s.

name: Leechtooth Flail
description: The teeth came from the river. So did the leeches.
passive_text: Your abilities that hit an enemy champion heal you for 3% of your missing health, up to 3 champions a cast.

name: Nightjar Wing
description: Nightjars hunt at dusk. They bring it with them.
active_text: Aim within 8m: for 3s, enemy champions in a 3.5m circle there see only 2m around them.
passive_text: Your abilities deal 10% more damage to champions whose sight is cut.

name: Shepherd's Whistle
description: The flock comes to the whistle, not to the dog.
passive_text: Allied champions within 9m who are moving toward you gain 0.5 move speed.

name: Witch's Ladder
description: A cord with feathers knotted in. Each knot holds one bad thing.
passive_text: You carry 3 knots. When an enemy champion's hit would take more than 8% of your max health, a knot unties and halves it; a knot reties every 20s.

name: Bargeman's Arbalest
description: Built for keeping boarders off the barge.
passive_text: When an enemy champion dashes or blinks to within 3m of you, your next basic on them within 2s knocks them 2m back and slows them 30% for 1s. Once every 10s.

name: Drowned Bell
description: It still rings under the millpond on still nights.
passive_text: An ability that hits 2 enemy champions deals 10% more damage to each; one that hits 3 or more deals 20% more.

name: Highwayman's Mask
description: Worn by the one who waits on the empty road. He sees you first.
passive_text: While no allied champion is within 15m of you, an enemy champion who comes within 12m is revealed for 3s. Once per champion every 20s.

name: Mourning Standard
description: Carried at the front of the siege, and at the back of the funeral.
active_text: Plant it at your feet for 8s. Allied champions within 6m of it deal 15% more damage to towers and monsters, and take 15% less from them.
passive_text: Allied minions within 6m of you deal 25% more damage to towers.

name: Sickle of the Last Sheaf
description: The last sheaf is cut together, and kept till spring.
passive_text: Your abilities deal 10% more damage to champions below 50% health.

name: Witch's Hourglass
description: Turn it over and the afternoon starts again. Then it sends the bill.
active_text: For 6s, your next 3 Q, W or E casts come back after 1s. When the 6s end, each ability cast this way goes on its full cooldown plus 2s.
passive_text: Each ability you cast takes 2s off Turn the Glass.

name: Coven Rod
description: Wych-elm wound with a whole coven's tally cords.
active_text: Target a point within 8m. After 0.6s, a 2.5m ring deals 50 + 35% AP + 4 per tally magic damage (50% more to monsters). Champions hit take 10% more damage from your abilities for 3s. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (30s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle legendary (Fell only). Your abilities deal 25% more damage to monsters. Count Them Off lands again 1s later for 60% damage; champions hit by both are stunned for 0.75s.

name: Mummer's Mask
description: Painted for the midwinter play. Nobody can say who wore it.
active_text: A mummer in your shape walks on the way you are moving for 4s. Enemies can't tell it from you until a champion hits it.
passive_text: An enemy champion who hits your mummer is revealed for 3s and slowed 30% for 1s.

name: Oathbreaker's Gage
description: Thrown at the feet. Picking it up is the answer.
active_text: Mark an enemy champion within 6m for 8s: you deal them 12% more damage and gain 0.4 move speed. If they get 10m away, the mark ends and they are slowed 40% for 1.5s and revealed for 3s.
passive_text: If your quarry dies while marked, heal 20% of your max health and the cooldown drops to 15s.

name: Ox-Yoke
description: Made for two oxen. One tank fills it.
passive_text: Your shoves, drags and pulls move enemies 30% farther.

name: Gloaming Hatchet
description: The Sootbrand when its keeper stopped needing the light. The dusk follows it about, and the wards along its road go blind.
active_text: For 4s, wards, towers and minions cannot see you; enemy champions within 7m still can. Dealing or taking damage ends it. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (30s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle legendary (Fell only). While Snuff the Lantern lasts, enemy wards and lanterns within 9m see nothing, and your first hit on a champion deals 40 + 60% bonus AD physical damage and slows them 35% for 1.5s.

name: Packbone Maul
description: A maul of thighbone and jaw from the hound ossuary. Every pack in the wood knows whose it is.
active_text: Near a camp (6m): its monsters attack the nearest enemy champion within 9m for 6s. If none is near, the camp does not attack you for 3s. Cooldown 1s shorter per tally (40s minimum).
passive_text: Jungle legendary (Fell only). Roused monsters hunt for 6s and move 25% faster, and champions they hit take 12% more damage from you for 3s. Monsters deal you 25% less damage.

name: Wakelight Crook
description: A shepherd's crook with the wake-lantern hung from its hook. Whatever it is held over belongs to the flock.
active_text: Mark the large or epic monster nearest your aim within 7m for 8s. Your team deals it 20% more damage; enemy champions, and their Fell, deal it 50% less.
passive_text: Jungle legendary (Fell only), keeps Wakebrand's burning camps and lanterns. Lanterns last 150s and see 8m.
